title: Soap Dish Wall Mount 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Lavender | Brass Soap Dishes | Allied Brass
description:
Keep bar soap off the countertop and finish your sink area with a clean, coordinated look in Lavender, which introduces soft, calming color that adds a touch of unexpected elegance, perfect for creating a spa-like retreat. This wall-mount soap dish frees up space at the vanity while adding a distinctive detail that fits transitional bathroom hardware styles.

Highlights:
- Lavender transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your bath: part of the Brass Soap Dishes collection for a pulled-together accessory set
- Match your décor: available in a variety of designer finishes for versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: wall mounted soap dish
- Material: solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 inches
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs
- Assembly: assembled in the U.S.A.
